name: Ho Yong Chol

attribution.legal_posture: Korea Daesong Bank-linked DPRK financial representative; Treasury reported that he facilitated transfers of over $2.5 million in U.S. dollars and Chinese yuan on behalf of Korea Daesong Bank and managed transactions worth over $85 million in U.S. dollars on behalf of another DPRK government-affiliated group; designated under E.O. 13551; administrative sanctions designation; no criminal charge or conviction is on record.

caveats: The source records an administrative designation and Treasury-reported conduct. Dandong, China is designation-era exact-entry context; residence, continued presence, and present location require separate evidence. Korea Daesong Bank has a source-explicit on-behalf-of and OFAC linked-to relationship; the other DPRK government-affiliated group is unnamed. The record scope excludes accounts, payments, counterparties, transactions, wallets, passports, birth, nationality, gender, contacts, precise addresses, and other sensitive selectors.

identity_boundary: Ho Yong Chol, listed by OFAC as HO, Yong Chol with Korean name 허용철 and alternate spelling HO', Yong-ch'o'l, is the Korea Daesong Bank-linked financial representative described in Treasury’s November 2025 sanctions action. Collective China-or-Russia wording leaves country, present location, and same-named public-account ownership unresolved. The source records an administrative-designation posture.
